correctness.method: `eslint .` and `pnpm run typecheck` (pnpm -r typecheck -> tsc --noEmit per package) run locally against main@45d0c64 (HEAD of capturedFromCommit) with the exact dependency versions pinned in pnpm-lock.yaml. typecheckErrors amended 2026-07-23 (rig#17): the original capture read 1, but `pnpm -r` bails at the FIRST package whose script fails, so with packages/rig's single error unfixed it never reached packages/rig-web and silently never ran rig-web's own `tsc --noEmit` -- the recorded '1' only ever reflected packages/rig, not the whole gate-visible surface. rig#17 fixed that one packages/rig error (src/cli/output.ts TS2345), which unmasked packages/rig-web's pre-existing, unrelated 154 errors (already tracked, out of scope, as the rig-web bucket in rig#3) now that `pnpm -r typecheck` runs to completion. No error count actually increased -- rig-web's debt predates this capture and this change; it was simply never exercised by the aggregate command before. Corrected here so the frozen baseline matches the true, now fully-run count and rig-web's real debt stays governed by the no-regression guard going forward instead of remaining invisible to it. Ratcheted 154 -> 135 on 2026-07-25 (rig#24, slice 2 of #3's burndown): fixed all 19 non-test src errors in packages/rig-web/src/web/relay-client.ts (16x TS4111, narrowed decodeEventFallback's Record<string,unknown> scratch object to a real NostrEvent object literal at its validation boundary instead of dot-accessing an index-signature type) and src/web/components/error-boundary.tsx (3x TS4114, added `override` to state/componentDidCatch/render). Lowering the baseline locks the fix in so a future PR can't silently reintroduce these 19 errors under the <= guard.
